answer: Burned entry fee: each new agent identity destroys 25 POA, non-refundable, then waits one epoch. An honest agent pays once and amortizes it over hundreds of epochs. An attacker fielding 1,000 fakes must burn 25,000 POA, and a fake caught attesting falsely loses rewards plus a 10 POA slash, so cost grows linearly with N. Re-registration cannot spiral out of control: each puppet starts at zero standing, a discarded fake is a relic with no resale value, and no vault refunds the fee. Limit: the fee must track POA price, or a crash makes entry nearly free.
